DebugConnectionMode.summary:
Choose the appropriate mode for connection.
NormalMode (0) Connect with normal mode, the target is reset then halted while the type of reset is selected using the [debugResetMode].
HotplugMode (1) Connect with under reset mode, option allows the user to connect to the target using a reset vector catch before executing any instruction.
UnderResetMode (2) Connect with under reset mode, option allows the user to connect to the target using a reset vector catch before executing any instruction.
PowerDownMode (3) Connect with power down mode.
PreResetMode (4) Connect with pre reset mode.
HwRstPulseMode (5) Connect with hwRstPulse mode.

NormalMode.summary: Connect with normal mode, the target is reset then halted while the type of reset is selected using the [debugResetMode].

HotplugMode.summary: Connect with hotplug mode, this option allows the user to connect to the target without halt or reset.

UnderResetMode.summary: Connect with under reset mode, option allows the user to connect to the target using a reset vector catch before executing any instruction.
